stories.title: Flint coastguards hit by ruling that strips emergency callout payments from volunteers
stories.summary: Coastguards from across the UK are set to gather in Westminster today, Wednesday, July 1, to demand the reinstatement of emergency callout payments cut following a court ruling. stories.summary: The UK Government has confirmed the early retirement of the Shadow R1 spy plane fleet, ending a programme that supported hundreds of jobs at Raytheon UK’s facility in Broughton. stories.title: Labour Senedd Member wants people to prove they can care for a rabbit before owning one

stories.title: Investment Zone grants set to create 79 jobs across Flintshire
stories.summary: Fifteen businesses across Flintshire have shared £898,461 in grants from the Flintshire and Wrexham Investment Zone, with the funding expected to unlock a further £1.2 million in private sector investment.
